column1: REPRODUCTION DOCUMENT — Not an original L&R Mfg. Co. technical publication. Reverse-engineered from direct physical measurement of specimen S/N 13505. Curated by Hobbs R.E. 2026. For restoration reference only.

GEOMETRY NOTES: Spherical ball (0.560") larger than both housing bottom openings (0.465" / 0.500") — ball seats on socket and self-retains. Bearing-to-housing height delta (~0.145-0.175") provides pocket space for felt washers each end. Housing socket OD 0.750" (CONFIRMED) matches BRG-012 spring large OD exactly. All values CONFIRMED by direct bench measurement.

FELT/RETAINER STACK per bearing — Upper: BRG-009 large felt washer (top) / BRG-001 bearing + BRG-012 spring at equator / BRG-010 small felt solid disc (below). Lower: BRG-009 large felt washer (top) / BRG-002 bearing + BRG-012 spring at equator / BRG-010 small felt with cutout (below) / BRG-011 metal retaining washer (bottom).
